title.note: Game title, glossary keep; Latvian players see Roblox titles in English.

hud.cast.note: 'iemest makšķeri' is the angling phrase for casting; infinitive, the Latvian button norm.

hud.reel.note: Vilkt = pull (the fish in); infinitive button, same verb as the pass Autovilkšana. Anglers also say 'spolēt' (wind the reel), but kids may not know it; 'Izvilkt' (pull out, 7) also fits if a native prefers it.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form; ēsma as a mass noun reads right for 0, 1 and 12.

catch.success.note: Restructured to 'Your catch: Golden Carp (Rare)!': Latvian cannot agree a tier adjective with a fish name it cannot see. loms (catch) is masculine, so the masculine tier tag reads as agreeing with it.

catch.escaped.note: 'It' made explicit as zivs (the fish); 'norāvās no āķa' (got off the hook) is the usual angling phrase.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: {weight} arrives as 12.4; Latvian writes 12,4. Format numbers per locale.

fish.golden_carp.note: Built like 'zelta zivtiņa' (goldfish). karpa is feminine with no masculine alternative, so a masculine tier tag after it (Mītisks) does not agree; catch.success frames it with masculine 'loms' to soften this.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Compound of laterna (lantern) + zutis (eel), keeping the glowing-lantern idea, modeled on species compounds like 'laternzivs' (lanternfish; unverified). Alternative: 'Laternas zutis' (14).

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine tier tag per the lv guide (Leģendārs below it). Reads as 'mythical', above legendary. Medium: next to the feminine 'Zelta karpa' the tag may look like an agreement slip to a native eye.

shop.equip.note: Lietot = use (this rod); infinitive button. 'Aprīkot' is the technical word but stiff for kids.

shop.equipped.note: State label 'in use'; avoids agreeing a participle with makšķere. Alternative 'Izvēlēta' (selected, 8).

shop.free.note: Bezmaksas is the standard Latvian price label (app stores); 9 vs the estimated budget 8. No shorter natural word: 'Velti' also means 'in vain'. Ask the developer for 9 characters.

shop.buy_robux.note: Robux undeclined after the number, per the lv guide.

pass.auto_reel.note: auto- compound on vilkšana (pulling), same verb as hud.reel Vilkt, built like 'autosaglabāšana' (autosave). Coined word; the Creator Hub pass name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Veiksmes ēsma divkāršo iespēju noķert retas zivis!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Veiksmes ēsma = luck (veiksme) + bait (ēsma), like Minecraft's 'Veiksmes dzira'. divkāršo = doubles; 'your' dropped (Latvian UI norm); retas matches the tier Rets.

sell.done.note: Restructured as 'Sold! Fish: {count}, coins: +{coins}' so 1, 21 and 340 all read right with Latvian plural forms; '+' marks the coins gained. For the developer: group thousands with a space (12 500).

sell.prompt.note: Comma before lai is required. Source-side issue for the developer: phone and console players have no E key.

ascend.button.note: Pacelties = rise, ascend; no religious sense in Latvian (the Ascension is 'Debesbraukšana') and not climbing ('kāpt'). A native may prefer 'Pārdzimt', the guide's rebirth word, but that would rename the mechanic.

ascend.confirm.text: Vai pacelties tagad? Tu sāksi no jauna, bet retas zivis ķersi par {bonus}% biežāk.
ascend.confirm.note: Yes/no question opens with Vai; future tense (sāksi, ķersi) is gender-neutral. 'start over' = sāksi no jauna. No space before %.

weather.storm.note: ķerties = to bite (angling sense); verb first = 'rare fish are biting'.

quest.catch_n.note: Label form 'Catch fish at Moonlit Bay: {n}', since '{n} zivis' breaks for 1 and 21 (1 zivs). Place name translated, so it takes the locative (līcī).

quest.claim.note: Saņemt = receive; not 'Pieprasīt' (request), per the lv guide.

friends.boost.note: Statement in label form: 'Fishing together with friends: luck +{percent}%'. No space before %.

trade.sent.note: {player} after a colon so the name takes no case ending. 'piedāvājums' (offer) is the natural Latvian word for a trade request; 'pieprasījums nosūtīts spēlētājam {player}' would be 44/33.

trade.accept.note: Simple past pieņēma is gender-neutral; 'your' dropped. Same 'maiņas piedāvājums' as trade.sent.

codes.enter.note: Informal tu imperative, as the lv guide prescribes.

afk.kicked.text: Tu pārāk ilgi neko nedarīji, tāpēc makšķerēšana apstājās.
afk.kicked.note: Restructured: 'You did nothing for too long, so fishing stopped' -- avoids gendered neaktīvs/neaktīva; no kick added.

event.ends.note: For the developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h' with English unit letters; Latvian writes '2 d. 4 st.'. Format durations per locale.

daily.streak.text: {day}. diena pēc kārtas! Nāc rīt atkal, lai saņemtu vēl.
daily.streak.note: Streak rendered as '{day}. diena pēc kārtas' (day N in a row), the plain Latvian way; the noun sērija (terms.json) would be vague here. Ordinal period after {day}. 'for more' = lai saņemtu vēl (to get more).

tip.night.text: Padoms: dažas zivis ķeras tikai naktī.

group.join.text: Pievienojies mūsu kopienai un saņem 50 ēsmas bez maksas!
group.join.note: kopiena = community: Roblox renamed Groups to Communities (lv guide). 'mūsu' (our) stands in for the English article: it is the studio's group.

leaderboard.biggest.note: Biggest fish; Latvian fishing contests award 'lielākā zivs' by weight. 'Smagākā zivs' (heaviest) fits too if the developer wants weight explicit.
